*---------------------------------------------------------------*
      *  Convert Claim Number                       Program: XACSCC00 *
      *---------------------------------------------------------------*
       01  XACSCC00-DATA.
      *---------------------------------------------------------------*
           05  PNCLAIM                PIC  X(011)         VALUE SPACES.
           05  CLPREFIX               PIC  X(002)         VALUE SPACES.
           05  CLSUFFIX               PIC  X(002)         VALUE SPACES.
           05  CLNUMBER               PIC  9(006)         VALUE ZEROES.
           05  CNPREFIX               PIC  X(001)         VALUE SPACES.
           05  CCN-OPTION             PIC  X(001).
               88  COMBINE-CLAIM-NBR       VALUE "C".
               88  SEPARATE-CLAIM-NBR      VALUE "S".
           05  CCN-MSGKEY             PIC  X(007).
               88  INVALID-CLAIM-FORMAT    VALUE "CCN0100".
